market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is one of many plausible 2028 contenders, but the election is far off and the field is wide open. Current implied odds of ~14% are far above a reasonable baseline for any individual candidate this far out, even a prominent senator. The true probability is likely in the low single digits.
evidence_points: Rubio lost the 2016 Republican primary and has not held a national office since.
The outcome of the 2024 election will heavily shape the 2028 candidate field, introducing massive uncertainty.
Historical betting markets show that individual candidates this far from an election rarely trade above 5% unless they are clear frontrunners.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of the US electoral cycle
